subject: Post-report interval affirmation request — SolarTek
thread_content:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@solartek.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@solartek.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for post-report interval affirmation (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Chloe,

Hope you’re doing well. We're in the final stages of our vendor security review and need a short "affirmation" or bridge letter confirming there haven't been any relevant control regressions since Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report period ended (report end date: 2025-12-31). Our audit window extends to 2026-04-30, so we need confirmation that controls have been in place through that date or any exceptions documented.

Specifically, could you provide the following:
- A one-page cover note or bridge letter stating whether any material changes or control failures occurred between 2026-01-01 and 2026-04-30.
- Any supporting artifacts for changes to cloud access, incident response, or encryption key management during that period (high level; we can request details if needed).
- Point of contact for a short follow-up call (15-20m) if we have clarifying questions.

We'd appreciate receiving the letter by 2026-04-22 to keep our procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Security Programs Manager
SolarTek

---

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@solartek.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for post-report interval affirmation (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We're able to support this. Quick outline of next steps from our side:

1) I’ll coordinate with Compliance and Legal to draft a concise bridge letter that affirms there were no unremediated control failures impacting the scope during 2026-01-01 through 2026-04-30, or documents any exceptions if present.
2) Kimberly and Irene — can you confirm whether any changes to KMS rotation, incident response runbooks, or org-level admin access occurred in that interval that should be noted? If there were changes, we’ll include a brief summary and attach redacted artifacts.
3) We’ll draft by EOD 2026-04-20 for internal review and share with Maya for SolarTek review on 2026-04-21.

Maya — our suggested POC for follow-up is Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.com).

Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for post-report interval affirmation (SOC 2 Type II)

Thanks Chloe — quick status update:
- KMS: Key rotation policy executed on 2026-02-03; rotation schedule unchanged. No unusual key compromises to report. I will attach the key rotation log excerpt (redacted) to the letter.
- Incident response: We had one low-severity incident on 2026-03-11 (failed automated patch on a staging node). It was contained, no customer data exposure, and fully remediated within 8 hours. I recommend we include a one-line note: "one low-severity, contained incident with no impact to production controls" and attach the incident tracker ID (internal).
- Admin access: Two role changes for platform engineers on 2026-01-22 as part of normal onboarding; no emergency escalations.

Irene — can you pull the SOC evidence extraction (access control matrix snapshot) for 2026-04-01 to include as a supporting artifact link? If not, I’ll reference the Drive folder.

Kimberly
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-report interval affirmation — draft attached

Hi Maya,

Attached is Redwood's draft affirmation for the post-report interval (2026-01-01 through 2026-04-30). Short summary below:

- Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covers period ending 2025-12-31. Between 2026-01-01 and 2026-04-30 there were no material control failures that affected the scope of the SOC 2 report.
- One low-severity, contained incident (2026-03-11) involved a failed automated patch in staging; no production or customer data impact.
- Normal KMS rotation occurred on 2026-02-03; no key compromise.
- Two routine admin role assignments on 2026-01-22 (onboarding).

Attachments included:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025-12-31.pdf (official report)
- draft_bridge_letter_SolarTek_20260420.docx (draft bridge letter)
- key_rotation_log_excerpt_202602.pdf (redacted)

Please let us know if you need additional redactions or a DocuSign-ready cover letter. If it looks good, we can finalize and have Legal sign off by tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
